defs.def: a flying insect with a long thin body and four large, usually brightly coloured, wings 蝴蝶

ex.s: The bees, butterfly and many other insects looked lovely and beautifully on the stamps.
ex.t: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶和许多其他昆虫在邮票上看起来可爱又美丽。

ex.s: From Snoopy to Spider-Man and bears to butterflies, there isn't much he hasn't drawn.
ex.t: 从史努比到蜘蛛侠，从熊到蝴蝶，没什么他没画过的。

ex.s: One of the most wonderful migrations in nature is that of the North American monarch butterfly.
ex.t: 自然界中最奇妙的迁徙之一，是北美帝王蝶的迁徙。

ex.s: Sadly, human activity is the main reason why the number of monarch butterflies is falling.
ex.t: 可悲的是，人类活动是帝王蝶数量下降的主要原因。

ex.s: In many of the places where the butterfly can be found, people are destroying the natural environment.
ex.t: 在许多能发现这种蝴蝶的地方，人们正在破坏自然环境。

ex.s: On the first day of my first grade，I stood by the door with butterflies in my stomach.
ex.t: 一年级开学第一天，我站在门口，心里像有蝴蝶扑腾般紧张不安。

ex.s: These two pieces of information - the time of day and the point where the sun is in the sky - allow the butterfly to determine the way to go.
ex.t: 这两个信息--一天中的时间和太阳在天空中的位置--让蝴蝶决定前进的方向。

defs.def: a swimming stroke in which you swim on your front and lift both arms forward at the same time while your legs move up and down together 蝶泳

ex.s: If this works, there may come a time when the number of monarch butterflies increases once again.
ex.t: 如果这奏效，或许有一天帝王蝶的数量会再次增长。
